title: Atlanta Plantation tour with Southern dinner
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Social life and culture of the souths most revered Era. Beautifully preserved southern plantations each uniquely diversed in history and architecture. Nestled in a small town-like atmosphere in Roswell Georgia, this tour experience will give a broader scope of life outside of Atlanta. Enjoy a complimentary local southern dinner at the end of the tour experience.
